hints.title: Greedy Ordering
hints.text: To keep prefix sums strictly positive as long as possible, place larger numbers before smaller numbers.

hints.title: Descending Sort
hints.text: Sort the entire array in non-increasing order.

hints.title: Positive Prefix Counting
hints.text: Compute running prefix sums and count how many remain strictly greater than 0 before non-positivity is reached.

hints.title: Descending Prefix Sum Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); single linear prefix scan takes O(n).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts descending to maintain positive prefix sums maximally.
